excerpts.section: ESC 2023 ACS Guidelines (doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehad191), Earth reference, no space data, 3.2 Diagnostic tools, Electrocardiogram
excerpts.text: It is recommended that an ECG is obtained immediately upon FMC

excerpts.section: ESC 2023 ACS Guidelines (doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehad191), Earth reference, no space data, 4.1 Pre-hospital logistics of care
excerpts.text: It is recommended that all medical and paramedical personnel caring for ACS patients within the EMS setting have access to defibrillation equipment and are trained in basic cardiac life support.
A defibrillator SHOULD only be used on a patient that is restrained to an electrically isolated and safe surface.

excerpts.section: Hinkelbein et al. 2020 (doi:10.1186/s13049-020-00793-y), rationale for Recommendation 10
excerpts.text: we recommend the use of a defibrillator only on a patient that has been restrained on an electrical isolated surface such as the CMRS

excerpts.section: Hinkelbein et al. 2020 (doi:10.1186/s13049-020-00793-y), rationale for Recommendation 21
